title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Liability Measures and How Each Tier Attaches
content:
Aurelia Hanse Line protects the cargo of each shipment through the tiers of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`. Two things distinguish the tiers at the most basic level: the yardstick against which the line's liability for a loss is measured, and the manner in which the tier comes to stand on a shipment. This card sets out both for all six tiers.

## Liability yardsticks

- **Hague-Visby limitation.** Liability is measured against the statutory Hague-Visby limits, which are expressed in Special Drawing Rights (SDR) for each package or unit and for each kilogram of gross weight.
- **Declared value.** Liability is measured against the cargo value that the cargo owner has declared on the transport document.
- **CargoCare cover.** Liability is measured by the protection purchased, inside the limits of the CargoCare product concerned.

Whatever the yardstick, SDR figures are turned into US dollars at the rate of the line's claims tariff, stated in USD for each SDR to four decimal places.

## Tier card

| Rank | Tier | Yardstick | How it comes onto a shipment | USD per SDR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | Hague-Visby limitation | attaches of its own accord when the line receives the cargo; carries no premium | 1.3385 |
| 2 | `AHL Declared Value Liability` | declared value | taken by the cargo owner, with the value declared on the transport document | 1.3385 |
| 3 | `AHL CargoCare Essential` | CargoCare cover | purchased CargoCare product | 1.3385 |
| 4 | `AHL CargoCare Plus` | CargoCare cover | purchased CargoCare product | 1.3385 |
| 5 | `AHL CargoCare Premium` | CargoCare cover | purchased CargoCare product | 1.3385 |
| 6 | `AHL CargoCare Total` | CargoCare cover | purchased CargoCare product, taken by the cargo owner | 1.3385 |

## Points of judgement

- *A shipment moves under the rank 1 tier. Which yardstick governs a loss?* The Hague-Visby limitation, because that is the only yardstick the statutory tier uses.
- *Does the SDR rate differ between tiers?* No. The tier card shows the same rate, 1.3385 USD per SDR, on every tier.
- *Is anything payable for the statutory tier to stand on a shipment?* No. It attaches when the cargo is received and carries no premium.
